metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a standing leg pain relief exercise that's perfect for desk workers, students, or for muscle tightness from sitting too long.

It's going to focus on hitting the front and back of the legs at the same time. This includes the quadriceps (quads), hamstrings, hip flexors, and calf muscles. 

Let us know how it works for you!
